xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5191: File explorer F: edit workspaces, Create PR, one-click merge, discard, pipeline PR

plan.title: File explorer F: edit workspaces, Create PR, one-click merge, discard, pipeline PR
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A project root in the file explorer is read-only: the main checkout must never be written, so nothing opened from a project home can be edited, and there is no way to turn a hand edit into a PR.
narratives.Proposal: The first save or file action on a project root creates or reuses an edit workspace (scratch/edit-<slug> worktree) through pan.explorerBeginEdit and moves the edit and every pane there. A banner on the edit workspace offers Create PR (direct PR with a one-click squash merge when GitHub reports it can merge, or Send through pipeline: GitHub issue, feature/<issue> push, ensurePRExists and PAN-4605 adoption into review) and Discard. A user page documents the whole explorer. The executable spec is .pan/drafts/pan-5191.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Send through pipeline for trackers other than GitHub Issues, or Create PR for forges other than GitHub.
- Carrying files that exist only in the main checkout (untracked, ignored, local-only commits) into an edit workspace.
- Renaming or moving the scratch worktree into a pipeline workspace (adoption replaces it).
- Polling PR state, AI-generated PR titles or bodies, stacked PRs.
- Git actions (stage, unstage, discard changes) or undo history on project roots.
- Automatic reaping of abandoned edit workspaces.
- Automated roles creating real GitHub PRs, issues or merges.
- Any write to the primary checkout working tree or index, any --no-verify, git stash, deep-wipe or --admin merge.
- Changes to pan workspace CLI behavior or to scratch workspaces that are not on a scratch/edit-* branch.

metadata.sizeJustification: This is child F (WI-14, WI-15, WI-16, WI-18 user page) of an epic the parent PRD already split into seven issues. Edit workspaces, Create PR, merge, discard and the pipeline send form one user flow over one route module and one banner: splitting them into sibling issues would ship a banner whose buttons lead nowhere, or routes no UI calls. About half the files are co-located tests, and the subsystem count is inflated because each top-level doc file (docs/*.md, features/*.mdx, docs.json, changelog.d) counts as its own subsystem.

autoDecisions.summary: PR, merge, discard and status are HTTP routes under /api/explorer/edit-workspaces/:workspaceId; begin-edit stays the existing RPC (D-F1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent WI-15 specifies these routes; the calls are long one-shot request/response, and no new RPC contract is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Send through pipeline uses PAN-4605 PR adoption instead of renaming and moving the scratch worktree (D-F2).
autoDecisions.rationale: A moved scratch worktree has no pipeline setup or proper registry row; adoption is the tested door that builds the pipeline workspace from a pushed feature/<issue> PR and starts review.

autoDecisions.summary: Send through pipeline is available only for projects whose tracker is GitHub Issues with an issue_prefix (D-F3).
autoDecisions.rationale: No dashboard route creates tracker issues today, per-project tracker construction uses loadConfigSync (forbidden in server code), and the explorer PR flow is GitHub-only anyway.

autoDecisions.summary: Direct PR creation uses argv gh pr create through runGh rather than the forge adapter (D-F4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The adapter builds a shell string with the title in double quotes, which an operator-typed title can break or inject into.

autoDecisions.summary: Pushes use the explorer git runner with git push [--set-upstream] origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, not gitPush (D-F5).
autoDecisions.rationale: gitPush fetches the branch from the remote first, which fails for a never-pushed branch, and it does not set upstream.

autoDecisions.summary: Repository commit and push hooks run; failures are returned verbatim and the default title is a conventional-commit subject (D-F6).
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo policy forbids --no-verify; a 2026-11-13 commitlint dry run rejected Fix typo in README and accepted chore: edit README.md.

autoDecisions.summary: Merge refuses unpushed work (409 UNPUSHED_CHANGES) instead of keeping a dirty workspace after merge (D-F8).
autoDecisions.rationale: A merge then never lands without the latest edits, and Push changes covers follow-up edits.

autoDecisions.summary: Code panes on an edit root show a one-line note; only the explorer pane shows the banner buttons (D-F16).
autoDecisions.rationale: Create PR and Discard in every code tab would be clutter; the explorer pane is the one control surface per root.

autoDecisions.summary: Automated roles do not create real GitHub PRs, issues or merges; those paths are verified with fakes and a local bare remote, plus an operator check (D-F17).
autoDecisions.rationale: They are outward-facing actions and a merge lands a commit on main.

autoDecisions.summary: Files that exist only in the main checkout are not carried into an edit workspace (D-F15).
autoDecisions.rationale: Edit workspaces are cut from origin/<default branch>; carrying untracked state is a separate feature.
